# Check what the html field should look like
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import run_postprocessors, render_inner_html, striptags

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
text = "# Foo & Bar {:data-toc-label='Custom & Label'}"

# Build the parser manually to inspect intermediate state
md.reset()
md.set_output_format('html')
md.registerExtensions(['toc', 'attr_list'], {})

# Parse the document
root = md.parser.parseDocument(text.split('\n\n'))

# Find the h1 element
for el in root.iter():
    if isinstance(el.tag, str) and el.tag.startswith('h'):
        print(f"Header {el.tag}:")
        print(f"  text={el.text!r}")
        print(f"  attrib={dict(el.attrib)}")
        
        # Get inner HTML
        inner = render_inner_html(md, el)
        print(f"  inner_html (before postprocessing)={inner!r}")
        
        # Postprocess
        processed = run_postprocessors(md, inner)
        print(f"  processed={processed!r}")
        
        # Strip tags
        stripped = striptags(processed)
        print(f"  stripped={stripped!r}")
